steps: 6 minutes: liquid yolk and soft white. Perfect in an egg cup.
6½ minutes: soft, jammy yolk. Best for eggs on toast or soft-boiled eggs in a salad.
8 minutes: soft yolk, but firm enough to hold its own.
10 minutes: the early stage of hard-boiled, with a smidge of softness in the middle.
12 minutes: hard-boiled with a lighter yolk.
14 minutes: traditional hard-boiled, lightest yolk and firm white, but not overcooked.

resolvedChecks.note: The page doesn't say whether timing starts in cold or boiling water; boiling water is assumed.
